## Purpose
The package of workflow revision layers. They change a saved workflow from an instruction (Refine with AI) into a reviewable proposal and never write to the stored workflow.

## Responsibilities
- The docstring explains the model's role: it is asked only which edit operations the instruction means, never for a definition, and everything after that is deterministic.
- An edit chosen in the UI arrives with its operations already given, and the intent layer skips.
- Once an error is set, or the instruction needs clarifying, the layers pass through. The proposal layer always runs.
- Re-exports: RevisionCodeFixLayer, RevisionDiagnosisLayer, RevisionPlanLayer, RevisionContextLayer, RevisionIntentLayer, RevisionApplyLayer, RevisionNormaliseLayer, RevisionValidationLayer, RevisionRepairLayer, RevisionDiffLayer, RevisionProposalLayer.

## Nuances and gotchas
